description: Utility class providing methods for handling WebDAV requests, including date formatting, XML document extraction, and user credential retrieval.

classes.name: WebDavUtil
classes.description: Final utility class for WebDAV-related helper methods, including date formatting, request XML parsing, and credential extraction.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string based on the provided format string, using GMT timezone.

methods.name: getDocumentFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts and parses an XML Document from the HttpServletRequest's input stream.

methods.name: getCredentialsFromRequest
methods.description: Retrieves user credentials from request parameters or HTTP Basic Authorization header, returning a map with login.username and login.password.

methods.name: getRFC1123DateFormat
methods.description: Returns the RFC1123 date format string used for date formatting.
